entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Alex. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 37 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?
Preference. I just changed my mind.
I see. And you're just not finding it useful?
It was an impulse buy. I just don't use it.

Okay, thank you for clarifying. Generally, for returns based on preference, we encourage customers to use our official VeloFit resale marketplace... but let me just confirm the exact policy for your specific item. One moment.

Thank you for your patience, Alex. Okay, I've reviewed your order and the policy. It looks like your purchase is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. My apologies for the confusion. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Right. So you're taking it back then.

Yes, of course. I have just initiated the return for you. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the device in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be credited back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
